component.name: Shadow of the Beast PC
component.summary: Unofficial PC port of Shadow of the Beast, bring your own game package

description.p: An unofficial native PC port of Shadow of the Beast (PS4). The game's own x86-64 code runs directly on the PC through replacement PS4 system libraries and a Vulkan renderer derived from shadPS4.
No game files are included. Install your own Shadow of the Beast package from the launcher: CUSA03762 1.00 (Korea), CUSA02871 1.00 (USA) or CUSA00951 1.00 (Europe).

ul.li: Render resolution, aspect ratio and True Ultrawide, SMAA, FSR 1 and texture filtering
Frame rate options from 30 to 240 FPS and Unlimited, with the game itself running at its original speed
Xbox and PlayStation button prompts, Skip Intro and Exit Game
Local trophies, Bug Report and a built-in updater
